problem.title: Minimum Cost to Hire K Workers
problem.problemStatement: Each worker has a quality and a minimum wage expectation. Determine the minimum total cost required to hire exactly K workers while satisfying proportional wage constraints.
problem.input: • First line contains integers N and K. • Second line contains N integers representing qualities. • Third line contains N integers representing minimum wages.
problem.output: Print the minimum hiring cost with appropriate precision.
